title: Find SKUs with Size Variant Codes
prompt: Your warehouse team needs to identify all product SKUs that follow the size-variant naming convention. A SKU follows this convention if it contains an underscore followed by exactly two uppercase letters representing the size code (for example, 'DRESS_SM', 'JACKET_XL', or 'BLOUSE_MD'). Write a query that returns all matching SKUs along with their product names and stock quantities. Return columns `sku`, `product_name`, and `stock_quantity`. Order the results by `sku` in ascending order.
example_input_data:
INSERT INTO inventory_items (sku, product_name, stock_quantity, last_restocked) VALUES

hints: You need to match SKUs that contain an underscore followed by a specific pattern of characters.
The pattern you're looking for is an underscore followed by exactly two uppercase letters. Use SIMILAR TO or a regex operator.
In PostgreSQL, you can use `sku ~ '_[A-Z]{2}$'` to match strings ending with underscore and exactly two uppercase letters, or `sku SIMILAR TO '%\_[A-Z][A-Z]'` if you escape the underscore.
answer_key:
SELECT sku, product_name, stock_quantity
FROM inventory_items
WHERE sku ~ '_[A-Z]{2}$'
ORDER BY sku;
